description: CYCLANDS: Cycling geo-located accidents, their details and severities is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Miguel Costa et al. Several cities and national authorities across the globe publish records on road accidents and crashes. These data support road safety analysis, allowing researchers to develop models to understand how different factors impact the frequency and severity of accidents. Coverage: not stated; published in 2022. Formats: CSV, GeoJSON, TXT. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is Open Access, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
